# Unmodified qCSF algorithm source

Source: CloudCompare commit `49dbbb662f296c7780aae717897c85b3cb3764ed`, directory `plugins/core/Standard/qCSF`.

https://github.com/CloudCompare/CloudCompare/tree/49dbbb662f296c7780aae717897c85b3cb3764ed/plugins/core/Standard/qCSF

The include and src files used by ALiSCSFCore are retained byte-for-byte with upstream LICENSE and license.txt. The original code is credited to the RAMM laboratory, Beijing Normal University, and authors identified in its headers. This folder is provenance/corresponding source; ALiS CMake uses the matching files from the CloudCompare source tree.
